contents.text: {"reason": "The agent's final message does not offer to pass the visitor on to Louis. The Offer tool call does include a card 'Tell me how we do it now' whose why says 'I'll pass it to Louis,' and a card 'Have Louis call me,' which are choices to pick, and the tool result says the cards end the answer. However, the criterion asks the agent's answer to offer passing them to Louis, and the offered choices (with the 'pass it to Louis' wording) do satisfy 'as a choice to pick' and nothing is sent yet, since the click only returns as a message. So the offer is present as a choice, and no sending occurs before the visitor clicks.", "met": true}
